description: Traverse the one-hop CDM relationship graph of an EU act: what it amends or is amended by, what it repeals or is repealed by (explicit and implicit), its consolidated versions, national transposition measures, its legal basis and the works adopted under it, the proposal it adopts (or, for a proposal, the act that adopted it), the CJEU rulings interpreting it (or, for a ruling, the acts it interprets), and works that cite it. Amendment, repeal, interpretation, and adoption rows carry the provisions CELLAR records each edge as targeting, and article narrows interpreted_by to the rulings on one article. Returns direct relations only, paginated per relation type and direction. Requires a CELEX number or CELLAR work URI.

article.description: Narrow interpreted_by to the rulings with a recorded provision in this article of the act: an article number with at most one letter (17, 6a), optionally prefixed "Article", "Art." or "Art", in any case. The article matches at any depth (17 matches provisions recorded in Article 17(1)(c)), leading zeros are ignored, and a letter also matches its Latin ordinal (28c matches Article 28 quater). Rulings CELLAR records no provision for are left out. Paging, has_more, and next_offset then count matching rulings only; other relation types are unaffected. With an explicit relation_types, include interpreted_by. A blank value is the same as omitting it.

anyOf.description: CELEX number of the work (e.g. 32016R0679). Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and the value is uppercased before validation.

celex_number.description: CELEX number of the work to traverse (e.g. 32016R0679). Provide exactly one of celex_number or work_uri.

limit.description: Maximum related works per relation type and direction, served up to 100 per call (default 100); a larger value (up to 10,000) is served at 100 and reported in limit_clamp. A response-budget cut can lower the common depth further to fit each complete surface within 64,000 UTF-8 bytes, never below 1; the notice reports requested/applied limits and withheld rows. Incoming edges are newest-first. Continue at next_offset for older works; narrow relation_types or lower limit for a smaller response.

member_states.description: Narrow national_transposition rows to the measures of these member states — the 27 member states plus the United Kingdom, by alpha-3 or two-letter code, in any case. Paging, has_more, and next_offset then count matching measures only; other relation types are unaffected. With an explicit relation_types, include national_transposition. An empty list is the same as omitting it.

items.description: A member state as its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (DEU, GRC, GBR for the United Kingdom) or two-letter code (DE; EL or GR for Greece; UK or GB), in any case.

offset.description: Pagination offset applied per relation type and direction — related works to skip (default 0). Continue at the returned next_offset, which adds the applied depth after any response-budget cut; incoming edges are newest-first, so higher offsets reach older works. Must be below 10,000: CELLAR sorts at most 10,000 related works per type and direction, so pages stop at row 10,000.

relation_types.description: Subset of relation types to return; omit for all fifteen, equivalent to listing them explicitly. Types: cites, amends, amended_by, repeals, repealed_by, implicitly_repeals, implicitly_repealed_by, legal_basis (treaty/article this act rests on), basis_for (works naming this act among their legal bases — implementing and delegated acts, decisions, Parliament resolutions, drafts; the incoming side of legal_basis), interprets (for a ruling: the acts it interprets), interpreted_by (CJEU and General Court rulings interpreting this act; the incoming side of interprets), consolidated_version (consolidated texts of this act), national_transposition (member-state implementing measures), adopts (the works this act adopts — usually its Commission proposal, also an international agreement its concluding decision adopts or a joint-committee decision; tell them apart by CELEX), adopted_by (the act that adopted this work; the incoming side of adopts). Whole rows, titles, and provisions are kept within a 64,000 UTF-8 byte budget per complete response surface by lowering the common per-type/direction depth, never below 1; a depth-1 page still over it has the provisions of its rows withheld whole, largest first (counted in provisions_withheld), and is then returned whole with disclosure. Name only the types you need to reduce the response.

work_uri.description: CELLAR work resource URI to traverse (e.g. http://publications.europa.eu/resource/cellar/3e485e15-11bd-11e6-ba9a-01aa75ed71a1). Used directly as the addressed work; its CELEX identity is resolved for the national_transposition act match, which stands down when the work carries several CELEX numbers — address such a work by celex_number to name the act you mean. Provide exactly one of celex_number or work_uri.

name: eurlex_get_relations

article.description: The article interpreted_by rows were narrowed to, normalized from the article input: the number without a prefix or leading zeros, any letter in lower case (17, 28c). Absent when no article filter was given.

cap.description: The per-direction cap. It bounds each relation type and each direction independently, so it is not an upper bound on shown: a page spanning several types and both directions can return more relations than this number.

celex_number.description: CELEX number of the source work whose relations were traversed — the celex_number input, or the CELEX resolved from work_uri when the addressed work carries exactly one. Absent when the addressed work carries none, carries several, or its identity was not resolved because no requested relation type needs it.

empty_relation_types.description: Requested relation types that returned zero relations in THIS page. Page-scoped: a type can appear here because all its edges sit beyond the current offset/limit window, not only because the act genuinely has none of that relation — so absent-from-here does not prove absent-in-CELLAR. An empty page — a first page with no edges, or an exhausted later page — returns all requested types here.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `offset_past_window`: offset is 10,000 or more, past the last row CELLAR sorts for one relation type and direction. `invalid_identifier_args`: Neither celex_number nor work_uri was provided, or both were. `member_states_not_applicable`: member_states was given with a relation_types list that does not include national_transposition, the only type it filters. `article_not_applicable`: article was given with a relation_types list that does not include interpreted_by, the only type it filters. `not_found`: The CELEX number, given directly or as a resource/celex/ work URI, is not found in CELLAR — resolve the identifier with eurlex_lookup_celex first. `sparql_error`: CELLAR rejected a query this traversal sent. The same call fails the same way again. `sparql_timeout`: A query this traversal sent ran past the client timeout, or CELLAR refused it as too costly to run. It is not retried. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when an additional valid row or a response-budget cut proves at least one requested relation type/direction has more rows. False on a retained page that ends at row 10,000, the last one CELLAR sorts; its notice names the types and directions that reached it.

limit_clamp.description: Present only when limit exceeded the per-call maximum: the value asked for and the value served. The response follows the applied value.

applied.description: The limit served: the per-call maximum.

requested.description: The limit the call asked for.

member_states.description: The member states national_transposition rows were narrowed to, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, normalized from member_states and de-duplicated. Absent when no member_states filter was given.

next_offset.description: Offset plus the applied per-type/direction depth after any response-budget cut. Present only when has_more is true; use this value to continue without skipping withheld rows.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: on an empty first page, how to widen the traversal; on a first page where member_states matched no national_transposition measures, the codes it named; with article, that interpreted_by leaves out rulings CELLAR records no provision for, or on a first page with none, the article it named; on a page with more rows, the offset to continue from; on a page ending at row 10,000, the relation types and directions that reached it, each with a ready-to-run eurlex_query_sparql query listing its older works; the rows whose provisions were withheld to fit the response budget, and the relation types whose provisions CELLAR did not return.

offset.description: Pagination offset applied to this response (per relation type and direction).

relations.description: Direct CDM relations for the requested work.

items.description: A single CDM relation between the source work and a related work.

direction.description: Direction: "outgoing" (this work → related) or "incoming" (related → this work).

provisions.description: The provisions CELLAR records this edge as targeting, distinct and sorted. They belong to the edge's object: this act on an incoming row (the articles a ruling interprets, the provisions an amending act changes), the related work on an outgoing one. Read for amends, amended_by, repeals, repealed_by, implicitly_repeals, implicitly_repealed_by, interprets, interpreted_by, adopts, and adopted_by; absent on other types and on an edge CELLAR records no provision for, which does not mean the edge reaches the whole act. Compact codes read A article, P paragraph, L point letter or subparagraph number, PT numbered point, T indent, and BIS/TER/QUATER… the Latin ordinal of a lettered article (A17P1LC is Article 17(1)(c), A28QUATER Article 28c). Authority codes precede numbers, each {CODE|URI} token written as its CODE: AR article, PA paragraph, PO or PTA point, AN annex, ALN unnumbered paragraph, TIRE indent, CHA chapter, TXT text (AR 43 PA 4 is Article 43(4)).

provisions_withheld.description: How many provisions this row has but does not carry: withheld whole, largest row first, to keep a one-row-per-direction page within 64,000 UTF-8 bytes per surface, and named in the notice. Name fewer relation_types to receive them. Absent when nothing was withheld.

related_celex_number.description: CELEX number of the related work, if available.

related_date.description: Document date of the related work (YYYY-MM-DD), the date rows are ordered by within each relation type and direction. Absent when CELLAR records none; such rows sort last.

related_member_state.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the member state whose national measure this is (e.g. "CZE"), read from the three letters after the directive number in related_celex_number. Present on national_transposition rows only. The codes are the 27 member states plus "GBR" (the United Kingdom).

related_title.description: The related work's English title, whole. Absent when the work has no English title — most national_transposition measures are titled only in their member state's language — with no other language substituted.

related_work_uri.description: CELLAR URI of the related work.

relation_type.description: Type of relation: cites, amends, amended_by, repeals, repealed_by, implicitly_repeals, implicitly_repealed_by, legal_basis, basis_for, interprets, interpreted_by, consolidated_version, national_transposition, adopts, adopted_by.

requested_relation_types.description: The relation types this request traversed — the explicit relation_types list, or all types when it was omitted. Diff against the types present in relations[], or read empty_relation_types, to confirm which requested types returned edges.

shown.description: Number of relations returned in this page, summed across every relation type and direction — not the count for any single type or direction.

total.description: Number of relations returned in this page (not a corpus-wide count).

truncated.description: True when an additional valid row proves at least one relation type/direction has more related works — page with offset.

work_uri.description: CELLAR URI of the source work (the work_uri input, or resolved from the CELEX).

title: Get CELLAR Relationship Graph
